name: tengun
description: 点群ビューア (Point Cloud Viewer) — 出来形管理・差分確認用の配布型ビューア

scripts.build: node tools/embed-wasm.mjs && node tools/embed-brand.mjs && npm run build -w @tengun/viewer
scripts.verify:import: node tools/verify-import.mjs dist/sample/full sample docs/screenshots sample/出来形.las
scripts.site: node packages/cli/src/ptv.js build --post sample/出来形.las --pre sample/起工測量.las --design sample/設計.xml --info sample/工事情報.json --out site-build --light-points 500000 && node tools/build-site.mjs site-build
